WebChartDateTimeUnitFormatOptions

Source: R/types-format-options.R
WebChartDateTimeUnitFormatOptions.Rd

A different date format per time unit, so an axis that zooms from years to hours relabels itself as it goes.

Usage

WebChartDateTimeUnitFormatOptions(
  year = NULL,
  month = NULL,
  day = NULL,
  hour = NULL,
  minute = NULL,
  second = NULL
)

Arguments

year

NULL or a IntlDateTimeFormatOptions object.

month

NULL or a IntlDateTimeFormatOptions object.

day

NULL or a IntlDateTimeFormatOptions object.

hour

NULL or a IntlDateTimeFormatOptions object.

minute

NULL or a IntlDateTimeFormatOptions object.

second

NULL or a IntlDateTimeFormatOptions object.

Value

An object of class WebChartDateTimeUnitFormatOptions.

Examples

WebChartDateTimeUnitFormatOptions(
  year = IntlDateTimeFormatOptions(
    year = IntlDateTimeDigitStyle("numeric")
  ),
  month = IntlDateTimeFormatOptions(
    month = IntlDateTimeFormatOptionsMonth("short")
  )
)
